definitions.gloss: snow cover; accumulated snow; snowfall depth
definitions.explanation: Snow that has accumulated on the ground. Also used to describe the depth of accumulated snow, frequently in weather reports.

examples.japanese: {積雪|せきせつ}が50センチを{超|こ}えた。
{積雪|せきせつ}のため、{道路|どうろ}が{通行止|つうこうど}めになった。
examples.english: The road was closed due to snow cover.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{例年|れいねん}より{積雪|せきせつ}{量|りょう}が{多|おお}く、{雪下|ゆきおろ}しの{作業|さぎょう}が{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: This year there's more snow accumulation than usual, making snow removal a real chore.

notes:
Commonly heard in weather forecasts and winter news reports. {積雪|せきせつ} measures the total depth of snow on the ground at a given time, as opposed to {降雪|こうせつ} (snowfall), which measures how much new snow has fallen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {積雪|せきせつ}{量|りょう} (amount of accumulated snow)
- {積雪|せきせつ}{地帯|ちたい} (snow-covered region)
- {積雪|せきせつ}{注意報|ちゅういほう} (snow accumulation advisory)
- {記録的|きろくてき}な{積雪|せきせつ} (record snowfall)

Distinguish from {降雪|こうせつ} (snowfall — the act of snow falling) and {残雪|ざんせつ} (lingering snow — snow remaining in spring).
